title: BHLHE40 as a transcriptional rheostat: decoding microenvironmental signals in context-dependent tumor plasticity.
snippet: The basic helix-loop-helix transcription factor BHLHE40 (also known as BHLHB2, DEC1, STRA13) functions as a critical molecular rheostat in cancer biology, exhibiting context-dependent roles that contribute to tumor plasticity. This review synthesizes current knowledge of BHLHE40, with emphasis on its structural features, including DNA binding, dimerization,...
